dispatchContext.memoryText:
- `src/rooms/relay/server/relay.ts` keeps the serialized `relay:items` value within `RELAY_LIMITS.maxStoredBytes` (about 200 KB): it prunes finished items oldest first, then truncates long text in open items. Open reminders and unanswered asks are preserved; storage remains one KV key.
- `src/rooms/native-install/native-install-bootstrap.ts` pins Lane Stack at `45fa19eab528d92d8ce2744d49153ecb4133ea33`. `src/rooms/native-agent/native-lane-reconcile.ts` re-copies OpenCode files on every reconcile, replacing a stale local guard; `tests/native-install-sha.test.ts` covers the pin and re-copy behavior.
- `src/rooms/native-agent/native-agent-overlay.ts` and `src/rooms/native-agent/bundled-agents.json` (kept identical) tell the PM that councils and workflow runs report their end to the chat by themselves. Tests covering the notices: `tests/server/pm-notices.test.ts`, `tests/server/council-tools.test.ts`, `tests/pm-instructions.test.ts` and `tests/workflow/`.
